h1: Order history migration, so nothing is lost in the move
overview: After a move you still need to look up what a customer bought last year. We export past orders from the old store and import them as historical records in the new one, with items, totals, dates, addresses and statuses. Imported orders are marked clearly as history and do not trigger emails or payments. You get a reconciliation sheet showing that the counts and totals match.

faq: Will imported orders send emails to customers?
No. We turn notifications off for the import and mark each order as historical. Customers see nothing, and stock levels are not reduced, so your live numbers stay correct.
Can customers see their old orders in their account?
That depends on the platform. Some link imported orders to the customer's account once they log in with the same email, others only show them to staff. We tell you which applies before we start.
Do payments and refunds get moved too?
We record the amounts and statuses so reports line up, but we cannot move actual payments or card data. Refunding an old order still happens in your previous payment provider's account.
How far back should I import?
Most stores import two to three years for support and tax questions and keep an archive file of the rest. We help you decide based on your order volume and the limits of the new platform.
